name: NanoClaw FreeBSD port (jails and ZFS snapshots)

mentions.name: NanoClaw FreeBSD port (jails and ZFS snapshots)
mentions.description: This project ports NanoClaw to run on FreeBSD using jails and ZFS snapshots instead of Docker containers. It is early-stage work motivated by the author's preference for the BSDs for personal use, since Docker images keep them tied to Linux otherwise.
mentions.problem: Docker and Linux are a constraint ('I use linux because I have to - docker/docker images is what we are stuck with'), prompting a BSD-native approach using jails and ZFS snapshots.
mentions.audience: Reliance on Linux and Docker images, which the author would rather avoid for personal computing, motivates a BSD-native alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt: looking at porting NanoClaw to use FreeBSD jails and ZFS snapshots. Why? I use linux because I have to - docker/docker images is what we are stuck with. For personal stuff - I prefer the BSDs.
